stereotypeDefinition.comment: Optional overrides for the file the Domain Event contract is merged into. Set only what differs from the convention.
stereotypeDefinition.name: File Config

property.hint: Optional. The existing file's name, with or without .cs; the file stays in this element's folder. With .cs the name is used exactly as written, so include it when the name starts or ends with a space (e.g. abc .cs); without it, surrounding spaces are trimmed. Elements with the same Filename in the same folder are generated into one file.
property.name: Filename

property.hint: Optional. Overrides the namespace derived from the element's folders. Every type sharing a file must have the same namespace.
property.name: Namespace

property.hint: Optional. Tick when the type is declared in the global namespace (no namespace declaration in the file). Leave Namespace empty.
property.name: No Namespace
